note: Forbidden: a Configure-Request with zero or more than one interface-identifier option. Sent side: TestIPv6CPProposesInterfaceID counts type-1 options in ze's raw initial CR and fails on iidCount != 1 (red on zero or two). Received side: TestIPv6CPRequestWithoutIdentifierIsNotAcked fails when a zero-option CR is ncpRequestAcceptable; TestIPv6CPDuplicateIdentifierOptionIsNotAcked fails when a two-option CR is Acked. Both polarities, both counts covered.
